ja480:1.1: Akittiṃ disvā sammantaṃ Sakko bhūtapati bravi: Kimatthiyaṃ mahābrahme eko sammasi ghammanīti.
ja480:2.1: Dukkho punabbhavo Sakka sarīrassa ca bhedanaṃ, sammohamaraṇaṃ dukkhaṃ, tasmā sammāmi Vāsavā 'ti.
ja480:3.1: Etasmiṃ te sulapite patirūpe subhāsite (p. 10,4 etc.) varaṃ; Kassapa te dammi yaṃ kiñci manas' icchasīti.
ja480:4.1: Varaṃ ce me ado Sakka sabbabhūtānam issara yena putte ca dāre ca dhanadhaññaṃ piyāni ca laddhā narā na tappanti so lobho na mayī vase ti.
ja480:5.1: Etasmiṃ te sulapite patirūpe subhāsite varaṃ Kassapa te dammi yaṃ kiñci manas' icchasi.
ja480:6.1: Varaṃ ce me ādo Sakka sabbabhūtānaṃ issara khettaṃ vatthuṃ hiraññañ ca gavāssaṃ dāsaporisaṃ yena jātena jīyanti so doso na mayī vase
ja480:8.1: Varaṃ ce me ado Sakka sabbabhūtānaṃ issara bālaṃ na passe na suṇe na ca bālena saṃvase, bālen' allāpasallāpaṃ na kare na ca rocaye.
ja480:9.1: Kin nu te akaraṃ bālo, vada Kassapa kāraṇaṃ! kena Kassapa bālassa dassanaṃ nābhikaṃkhasi.
ja480:10.1: Anayaṃ nayati dummedho adhurāyaṃ niyuñjati, dunnayo seyyaso hoti, sammā vutto pakuppati, vinayaṃ so na jānāti, sādhu tassa adassanaṃ.
ja480:12.1: Varaṃ ce me ado Sakka sabbabhūtānam issara dhīraṃ passe suṇe dhīraṃ dhīrena saha saṃvase, dhīren' allāpasallāpaṃ taṃ kare tañ ca rocaye.
ja480:13.1: Kin nu te akaraṃ dhīro, vada Kassapa kāraṇaṃ kena Kassapa dhīrassa dassanaṃ abhikaṃkhasi.
ja480:14.1: Nayaṃ nayati medhāvī adhurāyaṃ na yuñjati, sunayo seyyaso hoti, sammā vutto na kuppati, vinayaṃ so pajānāti, sādhu tena samāgamo.
ja480:16.1: Varaṃ ce me ado Sakka sabbabhūtānam issara tato ratyā vivasane suriyass' uggamanam pati dibbā bhakkhā pātubhaveyyuṃ sīlavanto ca yācakā.
ja480:17.1: Dadato ca me na khīyetha, datvā nānutapeyy' ahaṃ, dadaṃ cittaṃ pasādeyyaṃ, etaṃ Sakka varaṃ vare.
ja480:18.1: Etasmiṃ te sulapite patirūpe subhāsite varaṃ Kassapa te dammi yaṃ kiñci manas' icchasi.
ja480:19.1: Varaṃ ce me ado Sakka sabbabhūtānaṃ issara na maṃ puna upeyyāsi, etaṃ Sakka varaṃ vare.
ja480:20.1: Bahūhi vatacariyāhi narā ca atha nāriyo dassanaṃ m' ābhikaṃkhanti, kin nu me dassane bhayaṃ.
ja480:21.1: Taṃ tādisaṃ devavaṇṇiṃ sabbakāmasamiddhinaṃ disvā tapo pamajjeyyaṃ, etaṃ te dassane bhayan ti.
